commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90+7' Valencia take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+7' Hugo Duro (Valencia) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+4' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
90+2' This is a yellow card! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

90' Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a great save to deny Cristhian Stuani (Girona) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
87' The current number of shots on goal is 3:2.
85' Substitution. Andre Almeida (Valencia) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Largie Ramazani walks off.
83' Hugo Rincon (Girona) was too forceful with his tackle and Alejandro Ruiz interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
82' Hugo Rincon (Girona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Girona will take a corner kick.
80' Girona players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.

75' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
73' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

71' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Umar Sadiq will be replaced by Hugo Duro (Valencia).

71' Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.

69' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cristhian Stuani (Girona) replacing Azzedine Ounahi.

62' We are about to witness a subsitution. Joel Roca (Girona) for Thomas Lemar.

18' OFF THE POST! Lucas Beltran (Valencia) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
18' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
